signals.evidence: Citizen: 'I called the municipality about street safety for children with no substantive response, only bureaucratic delays and disconnected calls.' Radio host acknowledges 'pattern of citizen complaints being dismissed.'
Citizen describes 'repeatedly calling the municipality about street safety for children with no substantive response, only bureaucratic delays and disconnected calls.'

Citizen: 'I don't know what to do—I came this month and they told me I must return the license, but no one gave me an answer.' Lawyer: 'There is a lack of coordination between different departments and offices in the transportation ministry.'
Citizen: 'I don't know what to do—I came this month and they told me I must return the license, but no one gave me an answer.' Received conflicting instructions from multiple government offices.

Lawyer: 'There is persistent lack of coordination between departments and offices in the transportation ministry.' 'Why is there no representative, no field officer who can mediate and explain the procedures?'
Father of three: 'Without a license I have not worked in ten years—the license is a heavy burden and I am a father of three children. Many days I cannot start work because of the license problem.'
Citizen: 'I don't know what to do. Received contradictory advice from different government offices about the license status.'
Program anchor: 'We will coordinate this meeting' and 'We will not settle for anything less than an official response from the transportation ministry about this general chaos.'
Anchor: 'This issue has become widespread recently and has destroyed the peace of mind and tranquility of people who do not know or understand if they have a valid license or not.'

Caller: 'I have suffered for ten or fifteen years from flooding behind my house. They dug and found the sewage, put a sewage pit in front of my house, near the kitchen pillar. They said they would come back and move it, and they never came back.'
Caller describes three years of promised municipal action on sewage relocation with no follow-up: 'They said they would come back and move it, and they never came back.'
Resident: 'This sewage issue has been going on for three or four years, the water flooded the house... There is no proper sewage system and no drainage.'
Resident: 'They tell me we haven't dealt with you - there should be a street with sewage pipes in front of my house but they eliminated it.' Multiple complaints to local council without resolution.
Resident: 'This work is not right - the sewage pipes shouldn't run from the street directly into someone's home entrance and kitchen.' Infrastructure problems creating hazardous conditions.
Resident: 'The new official - through written complaint - they say they will look into it but nothing happens.' Multiple formal complaints and letters without response.

Emergency services announcement: 'In case of internet outages during conflict, information shouldn't be cut off - make sure you have a battery-operated radio in safe rooms. True, reliable news through Sun FM platforms during emergencies.'
